question: The Government of India has come out with a new set of National Awards in the field of Science, Technology and Innovation known as 'Rashtriya Vigyan Puraskar' in _____ categories.
solution:
The correct answer is __**four**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The Government of India has introduced a new set of National Awards in the field of Science, Technology, and Innovation.
 
• These awards are known as the 'Rashtriya Vigyan Puraskar'.
 
• The awards are categorized into four distinct categories.
 
• The initiative aims to recognize and reward exceptional contributions in the fields of Science, Technology, and Innovation.
